description: D1 table storing scored grant programs. Column names are snake_case as of migration 0002_schema_improvements.sql; the CSV/UI display layer maps these to human-readable headers (see ui/src/types.ts and worker.js's /api/grants row mapper).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Program name (unique; legacy join key when opportunity_id is absent)

fields.name: deadline
fields.description: Application deadline or next cohort date

fields.name: benefits
fields.description: Free-text benefits summary (formatted from award_floor/award_ceiling when sourced from Grants.gov)

fields.name: stack_required
fields.description: 0/1 boolean — whether sponsor stack is required

fields.name: notes
fields.description: User-owned notes/actions; never overwritten by a pipeline re-import

fields.name: pdf_url
fields.description: Reserved for future PDF attachment URL storage

fields.name: ai_scored_at
fields.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last AI scoring pass

fields.name: opportunity_id
fields.description: Grants.gov OpportunityID. Authoritative join key across ingestion sources (unique when non-null); nullable for manual/CSV rows

fields.name: cfda_numbers
fields.description: Comma-joined CFDA / Assistance Listing Numbers; used to deterministically dedupe cohort-year variants of the same program

fields.name: eligible_applicants
fields.description: Comma-joined structured eligible-applicant categories from Grants.gov

fields.name: is_forecast
fields.description: 0/1 boolean — 1 for forecasted (not yet posted) Grants.gov opportunities

fields.name: source_channel
fields.description: Ingestion channel that last wrote this row: 'xml_extract' | 'simpler_api' | 'csv_upload' | 'pipeline'

fields.name: last_synced_at
fields.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last successful sync from an authoritative source

scoring_rules: Relevance, Fit, and Ease are scored 0-3 and aggregated into Weighted Score. Update this contract when schemas or scoring rules change.
join_key_priority: Ingestion upserts prefer matching on opportunity_id when present (both incoming row and existing table row have one); otherwise fall back to name. This lets Grants.gov-sourced and manually-curated rows coexist without duplication.
